db_instance_id.description: The ID of an existing PolarDB instance.

i18n.en-US: The ID of an existing PolarDB instance.

backup_retention_period.description: The retention period of data backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据备份文件的保留天数。有效值：7~730。
i18n.en-US: The retention period of data backup files. Valid values: 7 to 730.

preferred_backup_period.description: The backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份周期。多个值用逗号分隔。有效值：Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday。
i18n.en-US: The backup cycle. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

preferred_backup_time.description: The backup time in format HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC time).

i18n.en-US: The backup time in format HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC time).

enable_backup_log.description: Whether to enable log backup. Valid values: 1 (enabled), 0 (disabled).

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用日志备份。有效值：1（启用），0（禁用）。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable log backup. Valid values: 1 (enabled), 0 (disabled).

compress_type.description: The backup compression method. Valid values: 0 (no compression), 1 (zlib), 2 (parallel zlib), 4 (quicklz), 8 (MySQL 8.0 quicklz).

i18n.zh-Hans: 备份压缩方式。有效值：0（不压缩），1（zlib），2（并行zlib），4（quicklz），8（MySQL 8.0 quicklz）。
i18n.en-US: The backup compression method. Valid values: 0 (no compression), 1 (zlib), 2 (parallel zlib), 4 (quicklz), 8 (MySQL 8.0 quicklz).
